description: Svelte checkboxes and radio buttons without bind:checked or checked={…}: their checked state is the DOM's. A plain checkbox toggled by a click, by Space on the focused box and through its label; a checkbox with a static checked attribute; one whose onchange reads e.currentTarget.checked, toggled by click and Space, keeping its state across an unrelated update; two radio buttons of a group without bind:group, checked by click and arrow keys
